thread:
simon: a customer reported inconsistent client signals when we fallback routes. sometimes 200+warning, sometimes 5xx. we need one consumer-visible taxonomy and clear retry semantics.

laura: examples?

ken: saw `200 {partial:true}` vs `502 {error: "backend_timeout"}` for same app request. client SDKs behave differently.

aditya: proposal: canonical client buckets: `OK_WITH_DEGRADATION` (200), `FAIL_RETRYABLE` (5xx), `FAIL_NON_RETRY` (4xx/429). expose `x-rw-client-reason` header and a `client_reason` body field.

pm_asha: product wants predictable contract across SDKs. header + body field sounds good.

laura: add a machine header for retry guidance: `x-rw-retry-hint: no|safe|idempotent`. and `x-rw-route-origin: primary|fallback|cached`.

ken: mapping examples:
INTERNAL QUOTA_EXCEEDED -> 429, x-rw-retry-hint: no, client_reason: FAIL_NON_RETRY
INTERNAL TIMEOUT -> 503, x-rw-retry-hint: safe, client_reason: FAIL_RETRYABLE
INTERNAL MODEL_DEGRADED -> 200, x-rw-retry-hint: no, client_reason: OK_WITH_DEGRADATION, x-rw-route-origin: fallback

maria: (ops) keep internal codes (MODEL_CRASH, TIMEOUT, QUOTA_EXCEEDED) in traces but don't expose them in default body. internal_code goes to support/debug pane only.

aditya: SDK behavior: parse x-rw-retry-hint. default rules: no => no retry, safe => exponential backoff with jitter (max 3), idempotent => immediate retry once. emit telemetry event `sdk.retry_attempt`.

pm_asha: console UX: badge pills for the three buckets and a debug pane showing internal_code. link to quota/billing on FAIL_NON_RETRY.

ci-bot: note - adding headers requires updating api-contract-tests and e2e mocks.

laura: rollout plan: 1) gateway emits headers + client_reason alongside current responses (2 weeks), 2) SDKs + console updates (4 weeks), 3) enforce canonical responses and remove legacy variants (6 weeks). announce deprecation in changelog.

ken: i'll add gateway mapping + tests. aditya will draft RFC with exact header casing, mapping table, sample responses, and SDK checklist. simon: lock naming for now unless objections by EOD.

simon: thanks all. opening PR. :rocket:
